additional_info.subject: ID0402537-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / S0 170004169] - Charging session stopped at PreCharge CRM:00315002313
additional_info.body:
Hello guys, good morning.
Regarding this topic of failing charging sessions during PreCharge here is the latest reply from EcoG.
“
The log message about “Error setting TCP_QUICKACK” is pointing to a sudden closing of the TCP connection from EV side.”
Please let me know when you find this error to have the customer not charge so that I can just gather a few logs. In AWS you can search for P04_PreCharge → P00_Unknown
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0402537-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / S0 170004169] - Charging session stopped at PreCharge CRM:00315002313
additional_info.body:
I don’t think the reason they are testing is directly related to this topic.
Solaris informed me that after we did an integration test this summer Catalina had some findings we wanted to bring to Solaris.
Someone in Siemens centrally and Solaris have had some dialog after the test, and they wanted to do some testing on site.
I have forwarded the findings they had so let’s see what the outcome will be.
But a question from my side, is this ticket/error the reason Depo 360 see chargers “stuck in preparing”?
They notify the costumer every time they see this fault and the costumer/D360 is now digging why they see charger getting stuck in preparing.
I have never seen it live myself but according to D360 its happening a lot.
/Simen

additional_info.subject: ID0402537-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / S0 170004169] - Charging session stopped at PreCharge CRM:00315002313
additional_info.body:
Hi Simen,
If there is already discussion with Catalina then I am not aware, I will check with her tomorrow in our daily call.
For the chargers that are stuck in preparing, I am not sure since I don't proactively check the chargers, I would recommend to use AWS and confirm the timestamps of these occurrences and align with the P04→P00. But from what I checked, after the P04→P00, they usually try charging again for a few more times, so I don't think it's stuck in preparing otherwise it wouldn't go through CableCheck.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0402537-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / S0 170004169] - Charging session stopped at PreCharge CRM:00315002313
additional_info.body:
Hi guys,
It seems we found the root cause for this, it's on our charger, apparently it's not giving the Requested Voltage on the right time (7sec) we see these drops after always 7sec and the NowVol ≠ TarVol.
As such I will create a ticket to R&D for analysis.
Thank you
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.body:
Hello colleagues, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
Just a quick feedback regarding this topic of the failures during PreCharge that lead to some occurrences of “Stuck in Preparing”. I applied a hotfix on 3 chargers
T241QR|bucVuF|64n1W8
And everything looks completely okay, there hasn't been this error since then.
Would you like me to apply this hotfix for all the chargers? I need your permission since this is an experimental upgrade, so it hasn't been tested in more than 10 chargers. If you rather, we can keep doing it like I've been doing so far with Simen, update 1, check for 1 week and keep doing until every charger has the update.
Let me know your feedback.
Thanks a lot!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0402537-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / S0 170004169] - Charging session stopped at PreCharge CRM:00315002313
additional_info.body:
Hi Benjamin, good morning.
Is there any other charger where you want to apply this hotfix?
I searched since last week and we haven't gotten the PreCharge failure.
Today we had a failure in PreCharge in bucVuF but it's due to a different problem:
When we have parallel sessions, we cannot ignore the feedback from the contactors
, to avoid any problems. So in this case you should replace QA21-22 so that it doesn't happen again.
For me this issue has been resolved with the hotfix, so there is no need to keep this ticket open. If you would like I can just apply this to every charger and close the ticket.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
